messages:
alex_finance: Heads up — NovaHealth's ACH setup bounced during bank verification this morning. Bank returned 'account-type mismatch'. Invoice INV-9421 attempted auto-debit at 07:12 and failed. Need fallback plan and whether we should auto-retry or wait for the customer to fix their account type.
sam_support: I reached out to the customer. They say they filed micro-deposits but selected 'Business' in their portal instead of 'Corporate' (screenshot attached). Customer asked what to do next and if we can accept an alternative payment method.
maria_sales: @alex_finance quick context: NovaHealth is on an annual commit and this invoice is their renewal. We should avoid any service interruption if possible. Is a card charge an option?
alex_finance: Card on file was declined last month (DECLINE_CARD). payments-bot shows last 3 attempts failed. For this one I recommend: 1) provide wire instructions as fallback, 2) put invoice on a short hold (72h) for them to correct ACH, 3) schedule a single manual retry after they confirm account-type fix. Also we need GL memo "Refund/Retry pending - INV-9421" once resolved.
dylan_ops: We can mark the invoice as 'manual review' and pause dunning in Stripe for 72h. Who can update the invoice status? I can if you approve.
sam_support: I'll update the invoice hold and send the customer a wire fallback + clear steps to correct the ACH type. Draft message below — please review: 
```
Hi NovaHealth team,

Thanks — we see the bank verification failed with "account-type mismatch". Two options:

1) Correct ACH: Log into your billing portal and change the account type to "Corporate". After that, confirm here and we'll run a single retry.

2) Wire transfer (fallback): Please use the following details and reply with the payment reference. Once received we'll mark INV-9421 as paid.

Bank: Redwood Community Bank
Account name: Redwood Inference (placeholder)
Account number: ####-####-XXXX
Routing: XXXXXXXX
Reference: INV-9421

If you'd like us to process a one-time card charge, reply with consent and we can attempt that as a last resort.

Thanks,
Redwood Billing
```
alex_finance: Draft looks good. Add explicit line: "Please reply with the payment confirmation or a screenshot of successful micro-deposit verification." And include verification link: https://pay.redwood.example/verify. Also log the attempted auto-debit and failure code (account-type mismatch) in the invoice notes.
payments-bot: Automatic retry scheduled for 72 hours from 1778009999. If the manual flag is not cleared before retry window, payments will escalate to collections per policy.
maria_sales: :thumbsup: I'll call my exec contact at NovaHealth this afternoon to speed up the fix. Keep me posted if you see any change.
alex_finance: Thanks all — sam, please send the message and update invoice hold. I'll add GL memo when payment completes or we confirm wire receipt.
